summary: Tested the per-branch store page, the Tampilan Toko editor and a re-check of the wishlist and Seller Center bugs. Backend: new suite test_iter57_store_page.py passed 10 of 11. Checked: /stores/{id}/page fields for all 3 branches (official phone present), 404 for an unknown store, own-products for official = only_branch only, Jombang own products sorted in-stock first and stock 0 last and not shown at Jember, auto featured = in-stock own products, manual featured kept in order with featured_manual true and the Jombang price, invalid id 400, more than 10 ids 422, a Jombang-own product rejected for Jember 400, permissions (jombang sees only own, PUT jember 403, demo 403, anonymous 401/403, admin 3 rows and can PUT any), upload PNG returns a /api/files url that can be downloaded, text/plain 400, cross-branch upload 403, GET /wishlist with X-Store-Id pgs-jombang = 362000 vs 360000 Sidoarjo without header. FAILED: the POST/DELETE /wishlist responses ignore X-Store-Id (Sidoarjo price). The app's wishlist state is set from those responses, so the bug fix is incomplete. Frontend at 390x844: demo Beranda store-switch -> pilih-toko -> pick Jember -> /shop/pgs-jember shows banner, logo overlapping the banner, name and shop-empty with a clear message plus Lihat Katalog; header-back returns to Beranda. Jombang /seller has Tampilan and Flash Sale tiles. Store-appearance fields save (PUT 200) and the preview shows desc/address/hours/phone with Telepon/WA buttons (44px high). shell-back is visible on mobile and returns to /seller. Admin sees 3 sa-store chips and switching works. 2 UI bugs: (1) sa-msg 'Tampilan toko disimpan' is cleared right after it renders; (2) the Featured search for Jombang/Jember returns nothing because it calls /products?store=pgs-jombang (own products only), so branch admins cannot pick shared catalog products. Appearance restored to the original values for all 3 branches and the test products were deleted.

critical.issue: Both return get_wishlist(owner) without passing X-Store-Id, so x_store_id is the Header() FieldInfo default and _ctx() falls back to Sidoarjo. With X-Store-Id pgs-jombang the POST response price is 360000 instead of 362000. cart-context.tsx:55-56 does setWishlist(w.items) from this response, so after a toggle the wishlist shows Sidoarjo prices until refresh. Fix: add x_store_id: Optional[str] = Header(default=None) to add_wishlist/remove_wishlist and call get_wishlist(owner, x_store_id). Reference: server.py:1036-1046

minor.issue: If every saved featured_id becomes unavailable, featured() falls back to the auto best sellers but featured_manual stays true, so the UI shows the title 'Produk Andalan' instead of 'Terlaris'. Reference: store_page.py:57-72

ui_bugs.issue: After a successful save, onSaved() replaces the list item, so the Editor's useEffect([a]) runs setMsg(null) and clears the message immediately. sa-msg 'Tampilan toko disimpan' renders briefly but is never visible; a MutationObserver confirmed it appeared and was gone right away. Reference: app/seller/store-appearance.tsx:84,91

Uses api.products({store: storeId, q}), which for pgs-jombang/pgs-jember returns only the store's own products (curl /products?store=pgs-jombang&q=Suggo -> []). Branch admins cannot add shared catalog products as featured, although the backend accepts them. Works for pgs-official (8 results). Fix: for branches, search the catalog with the X-Store-Id/branch context instead of store=. Reference: app/seller/store-appearance.tsx:46

integration_issues.flow: Wishlist toggle on a Jombang/Jember branch
integration_issues.issue: The wishlist state comes from the POST/DELETE response, which uses the Sidoarjo price (see backend critical).

action_items: server.py add_wishlist/remove_wishlist: accept the X-Store-Id header and pass it to get_wishlist (do not rely on the Header default when calling directly)
store-appearance.tsx Editor: do not clear msg when 'a' changes after a save (e.g. reset msg only when store_id changes, or set the message after onSaved via a ref/flag)

store-appearance.tsx FeaturedPicker: for pgs-jombang/pgs-jember, search the shared catalog plus branch-own products (pass X-Store-Id=storeId, without store=) so branch admins can pick featured products
Optional: set featured_manual=false (or return a flag) when the manual ids resolve to no products
critical_code_review_comments: get_wishlist is called directly as a Python function with a FastAPI Header default, which is fragile (FieldInfo object passed as x_store_id)
Shop page renders the global search bar above the ScreenHeader on web (two headers stacked), which is consistent with other pages but takes vertical space
The uploaded 1x1 TEST PNG (stores/pgs-jombang/...) is still in storage/uploads. It is not referenced by any store.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (flows work; sa-msg and branch featured search broken)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_Jombang products (deleted) and added pgs-10062 to the demo wishlist (removed). Appearance of all 3 branches was changed during the tests and then restored to the originals (description/phone values, empty banner/logo/address/hours/featured). An appearance_updated_at field was added to the store docs.

Original appearance: official desc 'Toko resmi Pusat Grosir Sidoarjo', phone 6281335551252; jombang/jember desc 'Toko resmi Mitra PGS Jombang/Jember', phone empty; everything else empty. UI login: go to the origin first, set localStorage pgs_auth_token, then page.goto the target. Grant geolocation in the context.
rca_of_issue: sa-msg: Editor useEffect(() => { setF(a); setMsg(null) }, [a]) fires on the new 'a' object that onSaved puts in the list. Wishlist: add/remove call get_wishlist(owner) without x_store_id. Featured search: /products?store=<branch> filters on store_id=<branch>, but shared catalog products have store_id=pgs-official.
